required_context: Applicable municipal jurisdiction and unresolved chapter-level actor and vehicle scope.

Complete ego path between those routes and contextual evidence bearing on through-route use.
Do not treat a stop or its duration as establishing or negating an exception.
Establish municipal jurisdiction, street status, authoritative route designations and full passage between the two truck routes.
Preserve unresolved chapter-level scope, supplied-definition applicability, actual control and automation information and all unresolved judgment meanings.
Retain contextual evidence for through-route use and for pick-up, delivery and essential use required enroute, including relevant premises and access activity.
